name: TypeScript monorepo: Node API + Next.js
description: pnpm workspace with a Node 22 TypeScript API (Hono or NestJS, Zod, Vitest) and a Next.js App Router frontend (React 19, Tailwind, Playwright). Prisma or Drizzle for data.

commands.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

backend_conventions: Node 22, TypeScript strict, ESM only; pnpm workspaces; commit `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
Validate every boundary with Zod schemas; derive types from schemas, never duplicate them.
Layers: `routes -> services -> domain + ports`; adapters implement ports; domain has no I/O.
Errors carry a stable `code`; HTTP layer maps them to problem+json.
Structured JSON logs with request IDs; never log secrets or personal data.
Database access only through the repository layer; migrations are versioned and forward-only.
Tests with Vitest; one in-memory fake per port; integration tests hit a disposable database.
frontend_conventions: Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict; Server Components by default, client components only when needed.
Design tokens in one place; Tailwind utilities from tokens only; no arbitrary values.
Every data view has loading, empty and error states; responsive from 360 px to 1600 px.
Forms validate with the same Zod schemas the API uses.
Tests: Vitest + Testing Library; Playwright for flows and visual baselines.
